Who are you?

That's you at the front of the room. Walk about with WASD (A/D turn, Q/E sidestep, Shift runs), drag to look around (the right button turns you too), scroll to zoom, right down to first person. Space jumps; Reset view shows the whole room again.

wheel: zoom 3–12× · drag: look · B or Esc: lower them
B: binoculars · T: teleport · W/S walk · Shift: run · A/D turn · Q/E sidestep · drag: look · right-drag: turn · both buttons: walk on · wheel: zoom · Space: jump (flying: up) · X: down · M: ride · Reset view: the whole room
